background_notes.fact: For R=Z_(p) and a field K of characteristic the prime p, the formula ρ(a/b)=ā b̄^(-1), using a representative with p∤b, defines a unital ring map. Its kernel is pR, and it identifies R/pR with the prime subfield Z/pZ of K.

grounds.reason: p is prime and K has characteristic p.
R consists of fractions admitting denominators not divisible by p.

background_notes.justification: An integer has zero image in K exactly when divisible by p. Cross multiplication proves independence of representatives and the ring laws. Thus a/b has zero image exactly when p divides a, equivalently a/b∈pR. For p∤b, integers u,t with ub+tp=1 show that the residue of a/b equals the residue of the integer au. Hence every residue is an integer residue, and their kernel is pZ.

background_notes.fact: For the Z-module M, R-module M_R=R⊗_Z M and the map ρ of S001, the displayed maps φ:M⊗_Z K→M_R⊗_R K and η:M_R⊗_R K→(M_R/pM_R)⊗_(Z/pZ)K are K-linear isomorphisms with the displayed inverses. They commute with extensions of compatible module endomorphisms.

grounds.reason: M_R is the stated tensor product.
ρ and the residue identification are established, and explicit forward and inverse formulas are given.

background_notes.justification: The formulas for φ and its inverse are additive and respect Z-balancing and R-balancing via ρ, so define tensor maps. Their composites are identities on pure tensors. For η, changing a lift z by pw changes z⊗c by w⊗ρ(p)c=0; R-balancing reduces to the residue identification R/pR=Z/pZ. Its two composites are likewise identities. Pure tensors generate these modules, and applying any compatible endomorphism before or after either map gives the same formula on each pure tensor.

background_notes.fact: If (u_i) indexed by the finite set I is an R-basis of M_R and ρ:R→K is a unital ring map, then (u_i⊗1) is a K-basis of M_R⊗_R K. An R-linear endomorphism with matrix (a_ij) in this basis extends with matrix (ρ(a_ij)).

grounds.reason: N004 gives the R-basis u_i=b e_i.
N001 makes I finite and supplies the integer action matrices on e_i.
S001 establishes ρ and the compatible transport φ.

background_notes.justification: For each basis coordinate map q_i:M_R→R, the map z⊗c↦ρ(q_i(z))c is well-defined and K-linear. These maps and the map (c_i)↦Σ_i u_i⊗c_i are inverse, by the finite coordinate expansion in M_R. This proves both independence and spanning. Applying an extended endomorphism to u_j⊗1 reduces its finite coordinate expansion coefficientwise by ρ; transport by φ preserves the formula.
